lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of quasi-rectilinear high-luminance clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the fifth branchial slit. The primary observable column contains approximately six distinct circular maxima, with subsequent posterior columns exhibiting increased inter-nodal distance along the horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like anchor system most visible in the mid-lateral region between the gills and the dorsal ridge.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal feature is visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient where high-intensity pixels on the upper surface transition abruptly to low-intensity shadow-cast pixels on the lower surface, following a linear path parallel to the spine.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct Echeneidae silhouettes are visible in the ventral foreground, characterized by high-contrast longitudinal white stripes against the ambient blue background.
